authoring_rule: Prompts were written from the five invocation contracts in integration-design.md, before reading any trigger regex in config/default-triggers.json. Fitting a prompt to a regex would make the router agree with itself.

contracts.second_opinion: One named independent model, clean underlying question, previous answer excluded.
contracts.answer_critique: One named independent model, previous answer deliberately included for critique.
contracts.standalone_panel: Identical prompt to several participants, fresh contexts, raw attributed answers, no synthesis.
contracts.debate: Participants deliberately interact; independence is not claimed.
contracts.synthesized_plan: Authorized planning owner obtains independent plans, then invokes the designated synthesis path, retaining disagreement.
contracts.none: No multi-model consultation is requested at all.

second_opinion.rationale: panel is many models; debate is interaction. Neither satisfies a one-model consultation.

answer_critique.rationale: same participant contract as second_opinion; only the prompt content differs.

standalone_panel.rationale: standalone panel stops after raw answers; auto-selecting synthesize would violate its contract.

synthesized_plan.rationale: an authorized merge is explicitly requested.

cases.prompt: ask codex to weigh in on this approach
cases.note: the previously demonstrated co-selection case; retained verbatim
